justifications.D1: "None found that substantially downgrade the hypothesis" — a guard exists (F1/F3 no-transfer gates, conservative band) but the core D-5-vs-D-8 contradiction is never surfaced or used as a kill condition, so the avoidance is incomplete.
justifications.D3: "Gate F2 ... +4.2pp ± 3.1pp (i.e., +1.1pp to +7.3pp)" plus "No early stopping based on intermediate results" — >=2 numeric falsifiers and an explicit stopping rule, but no cheap early mechanism-independent kill.
justifications.D4: "Seeded-random-library control (C_random) ... Shuffled-library control (C_shuffled)" — the known diversity/order/leakage confounds each get a concrete element, but there is no positive control demonstrating the instrument detects real signal.
justifications.D5: "Transplanting the D-5 terminal libraries ... into Ludus game-worlds as a circuit-seeding mechanism" — clearly new question, but no explicit statement of the new empirical cell relative to prior work.
justifications.D6: "Interpretation if failed: Library mechanism is substrate-specific" — gate-wise interpretations map most branches, but some outcomes (F2 overshoot → 'investigate') are procedures, not pre-committed conclusions.

justifications.D1: "set P1 threshold to +4–8pp (conservative) instead of assuming +10pp carryover" — risk acknowledged and partially guarded, but a ~50%-of-D-5 gain is still predicted with no D-8-null contradiction surfaced as a kill condition.
justifications.D3: "F1 (Primary): Transplant gain < +2pp CFR on worlds with depth ≥4" plus the scheduled-stop rule — numeric falsifiers F1-F6 and a stopping rule, but no cheap early mechanism-independent falsifier.
justifications.D4: "Ensure random-library control is drawn from D-5's actual genotype complexity distribution ... Report Kolmogorov-Smirnov test" — confounds each addressed by design, but no positive control demonstrating signal detectability.
justifications.D5: "libraries built on world-set A transfer ≥50% of within-A gains to held-out world-set B" — a clearly new cross-domain question, but no explicit new-cell framing relative to prior work.
justifications.D6: "F3 (Hindsight): Early-episode gain > +6pp but late-episode gain < +1pp" — falsifiers map to distinct mechanisms and F6 gives an uninformative reading, but mid-band outcomes between thresholds are unmapped.

justifications.D1: "expect near-null unless an explicit interface layer supplies the missing native-verb correspondence, and even then expect the random-library control to eat most of any apparent gain" — the naive-gain trap is converted into the decisive RAND (falsifier 3) and floor-replication (falsifier 5) tests.
justifications.D3: "FALSIFIED (RAW arm voided ...) if < 90% of RAW-arm artifacts execute without error" — numeric falsifiers plus a pilot stopping rule, with a cheap, early, mechanism-independent executability kill.
justifications.D4: "a 'vocabulary-only' control not yet built into the arm list above and flagged here as a design gap" — the known confounds are each addressed (RAND, per-world stratification, executability pre-gate) but the guard set is self-admittedly incomplete and there is no positive control.
justifications.D5: "transfer across substrate families (register-machine genotypes to card/dice game states) is the harder case, not the easier one" — explicitly states the new cross-substrate cell relative to G7's in-substrate null.
justifications.D6: "this is not a weaker version of D-5's G7 null — it is a full replication of it under harder (cross-substrate) conditions" — every branch, including voided-arm and underpowered readings, has a pre-committed interpretation.

justifications.D1: "D-8 blind S0 NO_EFFECT vs ... D-5 blind SUPPORTED +10.95pp ... directly lowered the point prediction from D-5's raw +10.95pp to ≈+4pp and made the full three-part G9 ablation ... mandatory" — the contradiction is surfaced and converted into kill conditions (falsifiers 3-5).
justifications.D3: "if the RM library ingests into Ludus without a rejected/coerced record for ≥1 artifact, treat as instrument failure" — a cheap, early, mechanism-independent falsifier plus numeric gates (+3pp, 60%/70% retention) and a hard run-once stopping rule.
justifications.D4: "Pre-hash the analysis script before any arm's rows are read" — each known confound has a concrete element (M1-random, M1-shuffled, CTRL family, budget metering), but no positive control demonstrating the instrument detects real signal.
justifications.D5: "the same 'accumulated history helps search' mechanism already flipped from SUPPORTED to NO_EFFECT once under a substrate change" — explicitly fills the third-substrate cell of the D-5/D-8 contradiction.
justifications.D6: "Full success requires ALL of: delta ≥ +3pp with p ≤ 0.05, shuffled retention ≥ 70%, AND random-library retention ≤ 60%" — every outcome branch, including instrument-failure and ceiling-effect readings, is pre-committed.

justifications.D1: "used as the direct quantitative anchor (CI spanning zero, p=0.21) for predicting a likely null, and motivated the M1-native control arm" — the D-5/D-8 contradiction is surfaced and converted into F4's decisive disambiguation.
justifications.D3: "F1 (Gate 0 hard stop): if < 70% of the sampled 16-20 D-5 artifacts survive translation ... stop before any solve-rate run" — a cheap early independent falsifier plus numeric F2-F5 under a sequential-gate stopping rule.
justifications.D4: "Gate 2 n=10/arm floor-effect pilot" and "Negative-control world ... predicted null in ALL arms, confirming that any null on the main world is not just a floor effect" — all summary confounds addressed plus reachability and positive-control (M1-native) checks.
justifications.D5: "we predict this replicates the D-8 pattern more often than the D-5 pattern" — explicitly fills the contradiction-resolution cell relative to prior work.
justifications.D6: "Any outcome where the 95% CI on the primary contrast includes zero is classified NOT_ESTABLISHED" — F1-F5 map every branch, including no-slot/vacuous and governance readings.
